{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PdfService where

import System.Process (readProcessWithExitCode)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, isSpace)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, unless)

data Role = Admin | Editor | Viewer deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data User = User
  { userId   :: String
  , userRole :: Role
  , userOrg  :: String
  } deriving (Show)

data PdfRequest = PdfRequest
  { reqTitle    :: String
  , reqContent  :: String
  , reqTemplate :: String
  , reqOptions  :: Map.Map String String
  } deriving (Show)

type AuditLog = IORef [(String, String)]

-- | Validates template name contains only safe characters
validateTemplateName :: String -> Bool
validateTemplateName name =
  all (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.') name
  && not (".." `isInfixOf` name)
  && length name < 64

-- | Sanitize content for LaTeX - escapes special characters
sanitizeLatex :: String -> String
sanitizeLatex = concatMap escapeChar
  where
    escapeChar '\\' = "\\textbackslash{}"
    escapeChar '{'  = "\\{"
    escapeChar '}'  = "\\}"
    escapeChar '$'  = "\\$"
    escapeChar '&'  = "\\&"
    escapeChar '#'  = "\\#"
    escapeChar '_'  = "\\_"
    escapeChar '%'  = "\\%"
    escapeChar '~'  = "\\textasciitilde{}"
    escapeChar '^'  = "\\textasciicircum{}"
    escapeChar c    = [c]

-- | Check if user has permission to use a given template
checkTemplateAccess :: User -> String -> Bool
checkTemplateAccess user template
  | userRole user == Admin  = True
  | userRole user == Editor = not ("restricted" `isPrefixOf` template)
  | otherwise               = template `elem` ["basic", "simple", "report"]

-- | Build PDF options string from validated map
buildOptionsString :: Map.Map String String -> String
buildOptionsString opts = unwords $ map formatOpt (Map.toList filtered)
  where
    allowedKeys = ["pagesize", "orientation", "margin", "font-size", "header"]
    filtered = Map.filterWithKey (\k _ -> k `elem` allowedKeys) opts
    formatOpt (k, v) = "--" ++ k ++ "=" ++ sanitizeOptionValue v

-- | Sanitize individual option values
sanitizeOptionValue :: String -> String
sanitizeOptionValue = filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c `elem` ".-_")

-- | Resolve the full template path
resolveTemplatePath :: String -> String -> String
resolveTemplatePath org template = "/opt/pdf-templates/" ++ org ++ "/" ++ template ++ ".tex"

-- | Core PDF generation - constructs and executes the rendering pipeline
generatePdfCore :: String -> String -> String -> String -> IO (Either String FilePath)
generatePdfCore templatePath title content options = do
  let outputPath = "/tmp/output-" ++ take 8 (filter isAlphaNum title) ++ ".pdf"
  let cmd = "pdflatex"
  let texInput = "\\input{" ++ templatePath ++ "}\n"
              ++ "\\title{" ++ sanitizeLatex title ++ "}\n"
              ++ "\\begin{document}\n"
              ++ sanitizeLatex content
              ++ "\n\\end{document}"
  -- Write tex to temp file and compile
  let texFile = "/tmp/input-" ++ take 8 (filter isAlphaNum title) ++ ".tex"
  writeFile texFile texInput
  (exitCode, stdout, stderr) <- readProcessWithExitCode "sh" ["-c", cmd ++ " -output-directory=/tmp " ++ options ++ " " ++ texFile] ""
  case exitCode of
    _ | "error" `isInfixOf` stderr -> return $ Left ("PDF generation failed: " ++ take 200 stderr)
    _ -> return $ Right outputPath

-- | Audit logging
logAccess :: AuditLog -> User -> String -> IO ()
logAccess ref user action = modifyIORef' ref ((userId user, action) :)

-- | Header value processing - applies organization-specific formatting
processHeaderValue :: User -> String -> String
processHeaderValue user val =
  let orgPrefix = userOrg user
      -- Allow org admins to use raw header directives
      processed = if userRole user == Admin
                  then val  -- admins can pass raw values
                  else sanitizeOptionValue val
  in orgPrefix ++ ": " ++ processed

-- | Main entry point for PDF generation with RBAC
generatePdf :: AuditLog -> User -> PdfRequest -> IO (Either String FilePath)
generatePdf auditLog user req = do
  -- Step 1: Validate template name
  unless (validateTemplateName (reqTemplate req)) $
    error "Invalid template name"
  
  -- Step 2: Check access control
  unless (checkTemplateAccess user (reqTemplate req)) $
    error "Access denied for template"
  
  -- Step 3: Log the access
  logAccess auditLog user ("generate:" ++ reqTemplate req)
  
  -- Step 4: Build options with header processing
  let baseOpts = buildOptionsString (reqOptions req)
  let headerVal = Map.findWithDefault "" "header" (reqOptions req)
  let processedHeader = processHeaderValue user headerVal
  let finalOpts = if null headerVal
                  then baseOpts
                  else baseOpts ++ " --header=" ++ processedHeader
  
  -- Step 5: Resolve template and generate
  let templatePath = resolveTemplatePath (userOrg user) (reqTemplate req)
  generatePdfCore templatePath (reqTitle req) (reqContent req) finalOpts
